# Command line

Every library call is also a command, generated from the library itself, so this page and [the Python API](index.md) describe the same operations. Function names become commands with dashes (`llmdyno.search_models()` is `llmdyno search-models`), methods of an object become `llmdyno <object> <method> ID` (`Run.transcript()` is `llmdyno run transcript RUN_ID`), parameters without a default are positional and the rest are `--options`. Keyword settings, such as the profile settings of `cloud-model` and `local-model`, go in `--set key=value`, read as JSON when the value parses (`--set ctx=32768 --set thinking=true`).

`llmdyno` on its own starts the web app, like `llmdyno serve`. `llmdyno --version` prints the version.

## Options every command takes

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Machine-readable output: JSON, or one JSON object per line for streams such as `watch`. |
| `--data DIR` | The data folder to use. Default: `LLMDYNO_DATA`, else the usual folder for your system. |
| `--url URL` | Run the command on a LLMDyno server on another machine. Default: `LLMDYNO_URL`, else this machine. See [Remote mode](../REMOTE.md). |
| `--api-token TOKEN` | That server's access token. Default: `LLMDYNO_TOKEN`. |
| `-h`, `--help` | Show the command's help and exit. |

## Server and maintenance

Hand-written commands that are not library calls.

### `llmdyno serve`

Start the web app and its API. `llmdyno` with no command does the same.

```text
llmdyno serve [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--host` | text | `127.0.0.1` | address to listen on; anything but 127.0.0.1 or localhost lets other machines in, and they need the access token (llmdyno token) |
| `--port` | integer |  | port (default: the port setting, 8777) |
| `--open` | flag |  | open the browser |

### `llmdyno doctor`

Print notes about this machine (architecture, GPU, memory) and the state of everything benchmarks need: Docker, the sandbox and code-quality images, llama.cpp, the harness images and the SWE-bench harness. `llmdyno setup` installs what is missing.

```text
llmdyno doctor
```

### `llmdyno specs`

Print the detected hardware (CPU, RAM, GPUs, driver, disks, Docker) as JSON.

```text
llmdyno specs
```

### `llmdyno ci`

Compare results with a baseline for CI: exit 1 when a configuration's score dropped by more than --max-drop points or is missing.

```text
llmdyno ci [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--baseline` | text, required |  | results JSON to compare with (llmdyno results --json) |
| `--plans` | text, one or more values |  | plans to check (default: every plan) |
| `--results` | text |  | a results JSON instead of --plans |
| `--metric` | text | `final` | final, correctness, quality, … (0-100) |
| `--max-drop` | number | `2.0` | allowed drop in points (default 2) |
| `--allow-missing` | flag |  | a configuration missing from the results is fine |
| `--save` | text |  | also save the current results there (next baseline) |

### `llmdyno token`

Print the API token remote clients and browsers must present. It is shown when it is made; --rotate replaces it (the old one stops working at once).

```text
llmdyno token [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--rotate` | flag |  | make a new token |

## Library calls

One command per `llmdyno.<function>()`, grouped like the API reference.

### Data folder

#### `llmdyno data-dir`

The data folder in use (models, runs, database, keys).

```text
llmdyno data-dir
```

### Setup, system and jobs

#### `llmdyno active-work`

What panic() would stop right now: running jobs, plans, containers and the llama-server.

```text
llmdyno active-work
```

#### `llmdyno cleanup`

Remove sandbox containers left behind by crashed or interrupted runs; returns how many were removed.

```text
llmdyno cleanup
```

#### `llmdyno clear-jobs`

Forget finished jobs (done, failed, cancelled, interrupted); returns how many were removed.

```text
llmdyno clear-jobs
```

#### `llmdyno gpu-usage`

Live GPU readings: utilisation, VRAM used and free, temperature and power for each GPU.

```text
llmdyno gpu-usage
```

#### `llmdyno install-docker`

Download and run the Docker Desktop installer (Windows and macOS; Linux uses the distribution's packages).

```text
llmdyno install-docker
```

#### `llmdyno list-jobs`

Background jobs, newest first (downloads, builds, plans, reviews, imports). active=True keeps the queued and
running ones; kind filters by type ("download", "build", "plan", "judge", "import", "install", …).

```text
llmdyno list-jobs [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--active` / `--no-active` | flag | `--no-active` |
| `--kind` | text |  |
| `--limit` | integer | `100` |

#### `llmdyno panic`

Stop everything at once (the red button): cancels every job and plan, kills LLMDyno's containers and the
llama-server. Finished runs are kept. Returns what was stopped.

```text
llmdyno panic
```

#### `llmdyno repair-docker`

Restart Docker Desktop after moving aside stale sockets that keep it from starting (a known Windows issue).

```text
llmdyno repair-docker
```

#### `llmdyno setup`

Install what benchmarks need, skipping what is already there: the sandbox image, the code-quality image,
harness images, a llama.cpp build for this machine (True picks the best one; or pass a variant such as "cuda-13",
"metal", "vulkan", "cpu"), and optionally the SWE-bench harness and the polyglot toolchain image.
These download several GB the first time. Docker must be running.

```text
llmdyno setup [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--harnesses` | text, one or more values | `pi` |
| `--quality` / `--no-quality` | flag | `--quality` |
| `--llama-cpp` | text | `True` |
| `--no-llama-cpp` | flag |  |
| `--swebench` / `--no-swebench` | flag | `--no-swebench` |
| `--polyglot` / `--no-polyglot` | flag | `--no-polyglot` |
| `--verbose` / `--no-verbose` | flag | `--no-verbose` |

#### `llmdyno start-docker`

Start Docker Desktop (Windows and macOS); it takes about a minute to come up.

```text
llmdyno start-docker
```

#### `llmdyno use-llama-cpp`

Use a llama.cpp build you already have (the folder holding llama-server) instead of installing one.

```text
llmdyno use-llama-cpp PATH
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `PATH` | positional, text |  |

### Profiles

#### `llmdyno cloud-model`

A cloud model to benchmark, e.g. cloud_model("anthropic", "claude-sonnet-5-5", reasoning_effort="low").

vendor: openai, anthropic, google, deepseek, moonshot, zai, qwen, minimax, xai, mistral, openrouter, groq, together,
fireworks, cerebras, litellm (a LiteLLM proxy: see litellm_model()), or custom (any OpenAI-compatible base_url,
such as Ollama or vLLM: see ollama_model() and openai_compatible()).
api_key: saved in the data folder (DPAPI-encrypted on Windows, a file only you can read elsewhere); when
omitted, the usual environment variable (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, …) or else the saved
key is used. The key only ever reaches LLMDyno's proxy.
budget_usd: hard spend cap of the provider, shared by all its models (new providers default to $5); on an
existing provider it changes the cap. base_url and api_style are provider settings too.
pricing: "auto" looks the model up in OpenRouter's catalog; or {"input": $, "output": $, "cached": $} per 1M tokens.
Other keywords are profile settings: ctx, max_output_tokens, reasoning_effort, temperature, top_p, extra_body.

```text
llmdyno cloud-model VENDOR MODEL [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VENDOR` | positional, text |  |  |
| `MODEL` | positional, text |  |  |
| `--api-key` | text |  |  |
| `--name` | text |  |  |
| `--base-url` | text |  |  |
| `--api-style` | text |  |  |
| `--budget-usd` | number |  |  |
| `--pricing` | JSON | `auto` |  |
| `--set KEY=VALUE` | text, repeatable |  | a setting; the value is read as JSON when it parses |

#### `llmdyno import-profile`

Create a profile from an exported profile file (a path or the dict Profile.export() returned). Its model
must already be downloaded here, or a provider of its vendor added, first.

```text
llmdyno import-profile SOURCE
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | positional, JSON |  |

#### `llmdyno list-profiles`

Every profile in the data folder (optionally only "local" or "cloud").

```text
llmdyno list-profiles [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--kind` | text |  |

#### `llmdyno local-model`

A GGUF model run by llama.cpp on this machine.

From Hugging Face: local_model("unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF", quant="UD-Q3_K_XL", ctx=49152) downloads the file
(resumable, checksum-verified) unless it is already in the data folder; download=False only uses what is there.
From disk: local_model(path="D:/models/qwen.gguf") registers the file where it is (no copy).
Other keywords are profile settings: ctx, cache_k / cache_v (or kv_cache for both), gpu_layers, n_cpu_moe,
flash_attn, thinking, max_output_tokens, temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, …

```text
llmdyno local-model [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--repo` | text |  |  |
| `--quant` | text |  |  |
| `--path` | text |  |  |
| `--name` | text |  |  |
| `--download` / `--no-download` | flag | `--download` |  |
| `--set KEY=VALUE` | text, repeatable |  | a setting; the value is read as JSON when it parses |

#### `llmdyno profile-defaults`

The settings a new profile starts from: for "local", tuned to a model (Model, id or name) and this machine;
for "cloud", the cloud defaults.

```text
llmdyno profile-defaults [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--kind` | text | `local` |
| `--model` | text |  |

### Models

#### `llmdyno download-model`

Download one quant of a Hugging Face GGUF repository into the models folder (resumable, checksum-verified).
Returns the Model when done, or the download Job with wait=False. An interrupted download resumes.

```text
llmdyno download-model REPO QUANT [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `REPO` | positional, text |  |
| `QUANT` | positional, text |  |
| `--wait` / `--no-wait` | flag | `--wait` |

#### `llmdyno estimate`

Will it fit, before downloading anything: reads the GGUF header over HTTP and projects GPU and system memory
for these settings (same keywords as local_model(): ctx, kv_cache, n_cpu_moe, …). Returns {"check": verdict,
projected memory and warnings, "contexts": the table for other context sizes, "params", "meta"}.

```text
llmdyno estimate REPO QUANT [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REPO` | positional, text |  |  |
| `QUANT` | positional, text |  |  |
| `--set KEY=VALUE` | text, repeatable |  | a setting; the value is read as JSON when it parses |

#### `llmdyno import-models`

Register the GGUF files in a folder where they are (nothing is copied); returns the models added.

```text
llmdyno import-models FOLDER
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `FOLDER` | positional, text |  |

#### `llmdyno list-models`

Models in the data folder, newest first; status="ready" keeps the usable ones.

```text
llmdyno list-models [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--status` | text |  |

#### `llmdyno recommended-models`

LLMDyno's suggested local models for coding agents, each with why and whether it is already downloaded.

```text
llmdyno recommended-models
```

#### `llmdyno repo-info`

A Hugging Face repository's GGUF variants (quant, size, files, a first fit hint for this GPU) plus its

#### `llmdyno litellm-model`

A model behind a LiteLLM proxy (Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex AI, … through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint):
litellm_model("bedrock/anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5", reasoning_effort="low"). Start the proxy yourself, e.g.
`litellm --model bedrock/...` or `litellm --config config.yaml` (pip install "litellm[proxy]"); base_url defaults
to it on this machine's port 4000. Prices come from LiteLLM's table when the litellm package is installed
("llmdyno[litellm]"); budgets cap spend as for any cloud provider.

```text
llmdyno litellm-model MODEL [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MODEL` | positional, text |  |  |
| `--base-url` | text |  |  |
| `--api-key` | text |  |  |
| `--name` | text |  |  |
| `--budget-usd` | number |  |  |
| `--pricing` | text | `auto` |  |
| `--set KEY=VALUE` | text, repeatable |  | a setting; the value is read as JSON when it parses |

#### `llmdyno local-servers`

OpenAI-compatible servers running on the machine LLMDyno runs on (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, SGLang, a
llama.cpp server, a LiteLLM proxy), each with its URL, the URL the sandbox uses, and its models.

```text
llmdyno local-servers
```

#### `llmdyno lookup-price`

Price per 1M tokens ({"input", "output", "cached"}, plus context length and the matched model) from
OpenRouter's catalog, or None when the model is not found.

```text
llmdyno lookup-price VENDOR MODEL
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `VENDOR` | positional, text |  |
| `MODEL` | positional, text |  |

A model served by Ollama on this machine, as a profile: ollama_model("qwen3-coder:30b", ctx=65536).

The JSON schema of a custom harness manifest.

### Your own agent as a harness

#### `llmdyno node-harness`

Make a harness from a JavaScript or TypeScript function ("agent.ts:run"; run, or the default export, when no
name is given). It runs on Node 24 in the sandbox, which runs TypeScript directly (type annotations only: no enums
or namespaces). packages are npm packages installed for it (pin versions, e.g. "ai@7.0.179"); when omitted, the
entry file's `export const PACKAGES = [...]` list is used, and a package.json in the source folder is installed
as well. source is the agent's file, or a folder that the entry point's path is
relative to (node_modules, .git and build output are left out). The function gets one object: prompt, model,
baseUrl, apiKey, workspace, stage, ctx, maxTokens, reasoning. id defaults to "js-<file name>".

```text
llmdyno node-harness ENTRYPOINT [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `ENTRYPOINT` | positional, text |  |
| `--packages` | text, one or more values |  |
| `--source` | text |  |
| `--id` | text |  |
| `--name` | text |  |
| `--apis` | text, one or more values | `openai-chat` |
| `--multi-stage` | text | `fresh` |
| `--build` / `--no-build` | flag | `--no-build` |
| `--replace` / `--no-replace` | flag | `--replace` |

#### `llmdyno python-harness`

Make a harness from a Python function ("module:function"). requirements are pip packages installed into the
image (pin versions for repeatable results); source is the module's file or package folder (found on your path
when omitted). id defaults to "py-<module>". replace=True updates an existing harness with that id.
build=True builds the image right away (it also builds on first use).

```text
llmdyno python-harness ENTRYPOINT [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `ENTRYPOINT` | positional, text |  |
| `--requirements` | text, one or more values |  |
| `--source` | text |  |
| `--id` | text |  |
| `--name` | text |  |
| `--apis` | text, one or more values | `openai-chat` |
| `--multi-stage` | text | `fresh` |
| `--build` / `--no-build` | flag | `--no-build` |
| `--replace` / `--no-replace` | flag | `--replace` |

### Plans

#### `llmdyno bench`

Run models × harnesses × benchmarks × iterations and return the scored Results.

models: Profiles (from cloud_model / local_model) or profile names. benchmarks: benchmark or suite ids
(see list_benchmarks() and list_suites()); harnesses: pi, opencode, codex, qwen-code, crush, aider, mini-swe-agent.
budget_usd caps this plan's cloud spend on top of each provider's own cap. Local models share the GPU one at a time;
cloud runs go in parallel. The plan is checked first and PreflightError lists anything that blocks it; danger
warnings (spill, out of memory, …) need acknowledge_risks=True. wait=False returns the running Plan instead;
on_event(ev) gets every live Event while it runs (see watch()). auto_log sends the results on when the plan
finishes: "mlflow", "wandb", "langfuse", "otel", a list of them, or {"mlflow": {"experiment": "x"}, …}.

```text
llmdyno bench MODELS … [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MODELS` | positional, text, one or more |  |  |
| `--benchmarks` | text, one or more values | `suite_quick` |  |
| `--harnesses` | text, one or more values | `pi` |  |
| `--iterations` | integer | `1` |  |
| `--name` | text |  |  |
| `--budget-usd` | number |  |  |
| `--quality` / `--no-quality` | flag | `--quality` |  |
| `--timeout-multiplier` | number |  |  |
| `--cloud-concurrency` | integer |  |  |
| `--allow-spill` / `--no-allow-spill` | flag | `--no-allow-spill` |  |
| `--acknowledge-risks` / `--no-acknowledge-risks` | flag | `--no-acknowledge-risks` |  |
| `--wait` / `--no-wait` | flag | `--wait` |  |
| `--auto-log` | text |  |  |
| `--view` | `leaderboard` / `runs` / `cells` / `rubric` / `agreement` / `reviews` / `reference` / `public` |  | which table of the results to show |
| `--export` | text |  | also save the Results page export there |
| `--level` | `runs` / `cells` / `configs` | `configs` |  |
| `--fmt` | `csv` / `json` | `csv` |  |

#### `llmdyno list-plans`

Every plan in the data folder, newest first.

#### `llmdyno judge-defaults`

LLMDyno's default judging setup: the rubric (dimensions with descriptions), the guidance judges get, and the
default budget, concurrency and output limit.

```text
llmdyno judge-defaults
```

#### `llmdyno review`

Blind LLM code review of finished runs by one or more judge profiles (cloud or local), then fresh Results
whose code-quality score includes the reviews. judges is required: a profile, its name, or a list (two from
different vendors let LLMDyno check agreement and self-preference). Review whole plans, or only some runs
with runs=.
budget_usd caps the judges' spend. rubric and guidance replace the defaults (see judge_defaults(): a rubric is a
list of {"key", "label", "description"} dimensions); include_static shows judges the static-analysis findings;
skip_reviewed=False reviews again runs a judge already reviewed. wait=False returns the Job.

```text
llmdyno review [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--plans` | text, one or more values |  |  |
| `--judges` | text, one or more values |  |  |
| `--runs` | text, one or more values |  |  |
| `--budget-usd` | number | `1.0` |  |
| `--concurrency` | integer | `4` |  |
| `--rubric` | text, one or more values |  |  |
| `--guidance` | text |  |  |
| `--include-static` / `--no-include-static` | flag | `--no-include-static` |  |
| `--max-output-tokens` | integer |  |  |
| `--skip-reviewed` / `--no-skip-reviewed` | flag | `--skip-reviewed` |  |
| `--wait` / `--no-wait` | flag | `--wait` |  |
| `--view` | `leaderboard` / `runs` / `cells` / `rubric` / `agreement` / `reviews` / `reference` / `public` |  | which table of the results to show |
| `--export` | text |  | also save the Results page export there |

### Live events

#### `llmdyno watch`

Iterate over what happens to a plan, run or job until it stops:

    plan = llmdyno.bench(qwen, "suite_quick", wait=False)
    for ev in llmdyno.watch(plan):
        if ev.kind == "run" and ev.finished:
            print(ev.data["benchmark_id"], ev.status, ev.data["correctness"])

Events come live from work running in this process (bench(), review(), downloads, …) and from a remote LLMDyno.
Work running elsewhere, such as in a separate web server on this machine, is followed by polling every poll_s
seconds (run and plan changes only). transcript=True adds every agent event and model request; gpu=False drops
the GPU samples. timeout (seconds) stops waiting early.

```text
llmdyno watch TARGET [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `TARGET` | positional, text |  |
| `--transcript` / `--no-transcript` | flag | `--no-transcript` |
| `--gpu` / `--no-gpu` | flag | `--gpu` |
| `--timeout` | number |  |
| `--poll-s` | number | `2.0` |

### Interop and CI

#### `llmdyno compare-results`

Compare results with a baseline, configuration by configuration (profile × harness), for CI. current and
baseline are Results, plan ids, or results JSON files (Results.to_json(), `llmdyno results --json`).
A configuration regresses when its metric (final, correctness, quality, … on 0-100) drops by more than max_drop
points; one missing from current fails the check unless allow_missing. Returns {"ok", "rows", "regressions",
"missing", "new"}.

```text
llmdyno compare-results CURRENT BASELINE [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `CURRENT` | positional, text |  |
| `BASELINE` | positional, text |  |
| `--metric` | text | `final` |
| `--max-drop` | number | `2.0` |
| `--allow-missing` / `--no-allow-missing` | flag | `--no-allow-missing` |

## Objects

Commands for one object, by id (or by name, where names are unique). `show` prints everything about it; the other actions are its methods.

### `llmdyno profile`

A model plus the settings it is benchmarked with (the app's "LLM profile").

| Action | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`show`](#llmdyno-profile-show) | everything about one profile |
| [`check`](#llmdyno-profile-check) | Memory fit for a local profile: verdict ("fits", "tight", "spill", "oom", …), projected GPU memory and warnings. |
| [`delete`](#llmdyno-profile-delete) | Delete the profile. |
| [`duplicate`](#llmdyno-profile-duplicate) | A copy ("<name> (copy)" unless you name it), optionally with changed settings. |
| [`export`](#llmdyno-profile-export) | The profile as a shareable file (settings, pricing and which model or vendor, never keys); written to path if given. |
| [`test`](#llmdyno-profile-test) | Quick test (about 20 s locally): loads the model, measures speed and VRAM, and checks tool calling. |
| [`update`](#llmdyno-profile-update) | Change settings, e.g. update(ctx=32768, cache_k="q4_0") or update(reasoning_effort="high"), and the name, notes, tags, pricing ({"input", "output", "cached"} USD per 1M tokens) or a cloud profile's model. |

#### `llmdyno profile show`

everything about one profile

```text
llmdyno profile show ID
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  |

| `ID` | positional, text |  | the profile's id or name |
| `--exact` / `--no-exact` | flag | `--no-exact` |  |

### `llmdyno benchmark`

| [`duplicate`](#llmdyno-benchmark-duplicate) | An editable copy under a new id (3-61 lowercase letters, digits or underscores). |

| [`spec`](#llmdyno-benchmark-spec) | The editable definition of one of your benchmarks (what create_benchmark() and update() take). |
| [`update`](#llmdyno-benchmark-update) | Replace one of your benchmarks with a new spec (built-in ones are read-only: duplicate() them first). |
| [`validate`](#llmdyno-benchmark-validate) | Check the grader: the starter workspace must fail it and the reference solution must pass. |

### `llmdyno plan`

A benchmark plan: its runs, live status, and results once it finishes.

| Action | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`show`](#llmdyno-plan-show) | everything about one plan |
| [`cancel`](#llmdyno-plan-cancel) | Stop the plan: running agents stop and those runs are marked cancelled; finished results are kept. |
| [`delete`](#llmdyno-plan-delete) | Delete the plan, its runs and reviews, and (unless files=False) the run folders: workspaces, logs. |
| [`get-runs`](#llmdyno-plan-get-runs) | Every run as a Run object (transcript, files, logs, retry, …). |
| [`live`](#llmdyno-plan-live) | A Jupyter widget that follows the plan as it runs (progress, finished runs, GPU); needs "llmdyno[notebook]". |
| [`open`](#llmdyno-plan-open) | Open this plan in the dashboard (starts the web app in the background if it is not running). |
| [`pause`](#llmdyno-plan-pause) | Pause the plan: runs in progress finish, queued runs wait for resume(). |
| [`rename`](#llmdyno-plan-rename) | Give the plan a new name. |
| [`results`](#llmdyno-plan-results) | Scored results of this plan, with the options of results() (weights, pass_threshold, …). |
| [`resume`](#llmdyno-plan-resume) | Continue a paused, cancelled or failed plan that still has queued runs. |
| [`retry`](#llmdyno-plan-retry) | Run the failed and cancelled runs again (or those with the given statuses) and, with wait=True, wait for the plan and return its Results; otherwise return how many runs were queued. |
| [`runs`](#llmdyno-plan-runs) | Every run with its status, scores and timing (dicts; run(id) or get_runs() give Run objects). |
| [`swebench-predictions`](#llmdyno-plan-swebench-predictions) | The plan's SWE-bench patches in the official predictions JSONL format (written to path if given). |
| [`wait`](#llmdyno-plan-wait) | Block until the plan stops, printing each run as it finishes, then return its Results. |

#### `llmdyno plan show`

everything about one plan

```text
llmdyno plan show ID
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  |

#### `llmdyno plan cancel`

Stop the plan: running agents stop and those runs are marked cancelled; finished results are kept.

```text
llmdyno plan cancel ID
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the plan's id or name |

#### `llmdyno plan delete`

Delete the plan, its runs and reviews, and (unless files=False) the run folders: workspaces, logs.


| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the plan's id or name |
| `--files` / `--no-files` | flag | `--files` |  |

Every run as a Run object (transcript, files, logs, retry, …).


| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the plan's id or name |


| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the plan's id or name |

Open this plan in the dashboard (starts the web app in the background if it is not running).

```text
llmdyno plan open ID
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the plan's id or name |

#### `llmdyno plan pause`

Pause the plan: runs in progress finish, queued runs wait for resume().

```text
llmdyno plan pause ID
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the plan's id or name |

#### `llmdyno plan rename`

Give the plan a new name.

```text
llmdyno plan rename ID NAME
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the plan's id or name |
| `NAME` | positional, text |  |  |

#### `llmdyno plan results`

Scored results of this plan, with the options of results() (weights, pass_threshold, …).

```text
llmdyno plan results ID [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the plan's id or name |
| `--set KEY=VALUE` | text, repeatable |  | a setting; the value is read as JSON when it parses |
| `--view` | `leaderboard` / `runs` / `cells` / `rubric` / `agreement` / `reviews` / `reference` / `public` |  | which table of the results to show |
| `--export` | text |  | also save the Results page export there |
| `--level` | `runs` / `cells` / `configs` | `configs` |  |
| `--fmt` | `csv` / `json` | `csv` |  |

#### `llmdyno plan resume`

Continue a paused, cancelled or failed plan that still has queued runs. Like bench(), it waits for the
plan and returns its Results; wait=False returns the Plan at once.

```text
llmdyno plan resume ID [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the plan's id or name |
| `--wait` / `--no-wait` | flag | `--wait` |  |

#### `llmdyno plan retry`

Run the failed and cancelled runs again (or those with the given statuses) and, with wait=True, wait for
the plan and return its Results; otherwise return how many runs were queued.

```text
llmdyno plan retry ID [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the plan's id or name |
| `--statuses` | text, one or more values | `failed cancelled` |  |
| `--wait` / `--no-wait` | flag | `--wait` |  |

#### `llmdyno plan runs`

Every run with its status, scores and timing (dicts; run(id) or get_runs() give Run objects).

```text
llmdyno plan runs ID
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the plan's id or name |

The plan's SWE-bench patches in the official predictions JSONL format (written to path if given).

```text
llmdyno plan swebench-predictions ID [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the plan's id or name |
| `--path` | text |  |  |

#### `llmdyno plan wait`

Block until the plan stops, printing each run as it finishes, then return its Results. on_event(ev) is
called for every live Event (see watch(); transcript=True adds agent events). progress shows a tqdm bar
(default: when tqdm is installed and the output is a terminal or notebook). Ctrl+C cancels the plan.

```text
llmdyno plan wait ID [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the plan's id or name |
| `--transcript` / `--no-transcript` | flag | `--no-transcript` |  |
| `--progress` | text |  |  |
| `--view` | `leaderboard` / `runs` / `cells` / `rubric` / `agreement` / `reviews` / `reference` / `public` |  | which table of the results to show |
| `--export` | text |  | also save the Results page export there |
| `--level` | `runs` / `cells` / `configs` | `configs` |  |
| `--fmt` | `csv` / `json` | `csv` |  |

### `llmdyno run`

One benchmark run: a profile × harness × benchmark × iteration, with its scores, transcript and workspace.

| Action | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`show`](#llmdyno-run-show) | everything about one run |
| [`cancel`](#llmdyno-run-cancel) | Stop the run. |
| [`download`](#llmdyno-run-download) | Save the run's workspace as a zip (default: <run id>-workspace.zip in the current folder). |
| [`files`](#llmdyno-run-files) | Files the agent left in its workspace (home=True: the agent's home folder, with its config and sessions): [{"path", "size", "mtime"}]. |
| [`gpu`](#llmdyno-run-gpu) | GPU telemetry samples taken while the run was going (utilisation, VRAM, power, temperature). |
| [`log`](#llmdyno-run-log) | The harness's output for one stage (stream "stdout" or "stderr"); the last 400 kB. |
| [`plan`](#llmdyno-run-plan) | The plan this run belongs to. |
| [`read-file`](#llmdyno-run-read-file) | A workspace file's text (or a note when it is binary or larger than 2 MB). |
| [`regrade`](#llmdyno-run-regrade) | Grade the finished workspace again (after fixing a grader, say) without re-running the agent. |
| [`requests`](#llmdyno-run-requests) | Each model request through LLMDyno's proxy: tokens, timings, time to first token, cost, finish reason. |
| [`retry`](#llmdyno-run-retry) | Queue the run again (its old results are cleared). |
| [`server-log`](#llmdyno-run-server-log) | The llama-server log of the plan's local model (empty for cloud runs). |
| [`transcript`](#llmdyno-run-transcript) | Everything the agent and the model said, as a Transcript (turns(), tool_calls(), thinking(), usage()). |

### `llmdyno job`

A background task: a download, image build, plan, review or import.

| Action | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`show`](#llmdyno-job-show) | everything about one job |
| [`cancel`](#llmdyno-job-cancel) | Stop the job (a download keeps what it has, a plan keeps finished runs). |
| [`drain`](#llmdyno-job-drain) | Wait (quietly) for a cancelled job to actually stop. |
| [`wait`](#llmdyno-job-wait) | Block until the job ends, printing its progress, and return its result. |

#### `llmdyno job show`

everything about one job

```text
llmdyno job show ID
```

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  |

#### `llmdyno job cancel`

Stop the job (a download keeps what it has, a plan keeps finished runs).

```text
llmdyno job cancel ID
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the job's id or name |

#### `llmdyno job drain`

Wait (quietly) for a cancelled job to actually stop.

```text
llmdyno job drain ID [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the job's id or name |
| `--timeout-s` | integer | `120` |  |

#### `llmdyno job wait`

Block until the job ends, printing its progress, and return its result. Ctrl+C cancels the job;
a failed, cancelled, paused or interrupted job raises LLMDynoError.

```text
llmdyno job wait ID [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | positional, text |  | the job's id or name |
| `--verbose` / `--no-verbose` | flag | `--no-verbose` |  |
| `--every-s` | number | `2.0` |  |
